# Insight Counseling Services (ICS)

> Professional, confidential, and evidence-based psychological counseling and therapy services in Chennai, India. Founded in 2014 by Counseling Psychologist Mrs. Lekha Edwin.

## About Insight Counseling Services
Insight Counseling Services provides confidential in-person counseling at clinics in Kovur, Porur, and Vadapalani (Chennai) as well as secure online therapy sessions for clients worldwide.

## Key Information
- **Founder & Lead Psychologist**: Mrs. Lekha Edwin (Counseling Psychologist)
- **Primary Location**: Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India (Kovur, Porur, Vadapalani)
- **Services Offered**: Individual Therapy, Couple Counseling, Teen Counseling, Academic Stress Management, Anxiety & Depression Therapy, Anger Management, Grief Counseling, LGBTQ+ Affirmative Therapy, Online Counseling.
- **Session Duration**: 50 minutes (Individual), up to 75 minutes (Couple / Family).
